name: setup-manaflow-ai-lumen-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces. The window and everything on it (sidebar, tab bar, title area) is system glass in one neutral tint over your wallpaper; the agent chat, terminal, editor, diffs, pages and Settings sit on a near-solid plane inset in that glass. Depth is the only hierarchy: no painted rims, glows or extra lines. Theme files for color and material (Lumen, dark, the default; Lumen Light), a few settings, and a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for quiet cards and the prompt bubble. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.themes/lumen-light.json:
// Lumen Light: the same app made of light, in its light theme. Neutral window glass over your own
// wallpaper, chrome that is that glass, the work on a calm near-solid plane.
{
  "name": "Lumen Light",
  "description": "Light: neutral window glass over your wallpaper, a calm 0.96 content plane, one deep blue.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  // background: the one neutral tint of both materials. foreground: the text, dark enough that the app's
  // own muted ink (a mix of text and background) holds 4.5:1 on this page. selection: a pale accent, the
  // text at 14.1:1 on it.
  // accent: links, focus and Send. The terminal palette is quiet and neutral, each colour solved in
  // OKLCH so 1 to 7 and 9 to 15 hold 4.5:1 or more (8, the dim gray, 3:1) over the content plane
  // drawn at 0.96 over a pure black and a pure white backdrop (minimum 4.71:1).
  "colors": {
    "background": "#f4f5f7",
    "foreground": "#0c0d0f",
    "selection": "#cfdcf5",
    "accent": "#1a56c4",
    "0": "#292a2d",
    "1": "#9d524d",
    "2": "#3c733f",
    "3": "#826311",
    "4": "#3e69a0",
    "5": "#84578f",
    "6": "#007379",
    "7": "#55585c",
    "8": "#7f8287",
    "9": "#954b47",
    "10": "#356c39",
    "11": "#7c5c04",
    "12": "#376299",
    "13": "#7d5088",
    "14": "#006c72",
    "15": "#1b1c1f",
    "cursor": "#1f5fd6"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  // Window glass: the window and all chrome on it. System glass, your own wallpaper behind it, a
  // neutral tint that never takes the desktop's colour cast. 0.8 is the least fill that keeps
  // chrome text readable over light, dark and busy pictures.
  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "glass",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.8,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": false,

  // Layout: the content is one inset plane on the glass, no outline around a lone pane, no
  // shade, no sidebar line: the change of material is the edge. Lines stay only between two
  // content panes, where both sides are the same material.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "card",
  "appearance.borders": "default",
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "same",
  "sidebar.border": false,
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "oneColor",
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "tabs",
  // Two tone is material, not hue: the selected tab takes the content plane's fill and joins it.
  "appearance.twoTone": "off",
  "appearance.cornerFlush": "flush",
  // A selected row spends one lever, its fill.
  "appearance.selection": "neutral",

  // Corners from one rule, inner = outer minus inset: a 16 pt window corner, an 8 pt gap, 8 pt
  // panes.
  "layout.cornerPadding": 8,
  "layout.paneCornerRadius": 8,

  // The sidebar and the tab bar show the window glass: the same tint at the window's own fill, so
  // they add no second tone (a surface's opacity is its fill over the glass, in place of the
  // window's, not on top of it).
  "sidebar.look": "cmux",
  "sidebar.style": "standard",
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.8,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 0.8,

  // Content: every work surface is the calm near-solid plane, fill 0.96, no blur of its own.
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.96,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.96,
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.opacity": 0.96,
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.opacity": 0.96,
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.opacity": 0.96,
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.opacity": 0.96,
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.opacity": 0.96,
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.opacity": 0.96,
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.opacity": 0.96,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.96,
  "appearance.surfaces.home.color": "#f4f5f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.home.opacity": 0.96,

  // The address field: if you turn its glass on, it takes no tint of the accent.
  "browser.omnibar.glassTint": "none"
}
